subject: Your tote quote
body: The printed totes are 8 each for the quantity you requested. That is the price you would pay, including the single-colour print. Let me know whether you want the natural or grey fabric.
why: SPEC §5.5 does not flag customer-facing prices and quotes; 8 is the price actually quoted to this recipient, not our cost.

subject: Front windows
body: For your front windows, our quote is 65 for the visit. It includes the frames and sills. We can book the work once you confirm which morning suits you.
why: SPEC §5.5 does not flag customer-facing quotes; the stated amount is the recipient's offered service price.

subject: Chair repair total
body: The amount due for your repaired chair is 92. The loose joint and the seat webbing are both finished. You can collect it tomorrow afternoon if convenient.
why: SPEC §5.5 does not flag invoice amounts stated as facts; this is the customer's amount due, with no cost build-up.

subject: Course booking
body: Your course booking is confirmed at 240. Payment is due before the first session, as shown on the booking form. We will leave the workbook at reception for you.
why: SPEC §5.5 does not flag customer-facing prices and payment terms stated as facts; no internal economics are given.

subject: Noticeboard order
body: The agreed value of your noticeboard order is 780. The blue fabric and aluminium frame are confirmed. Please check the delivery address on your order copy before we book the van.
why: SPEC §5.5 does not flag contract values stated as facts; this is the recipient's agreed order value.

subject: Lamp quote breakdown
body: Your quote breaks down as 40 for cleaning, 25 for rewiring and 15 for the new fitting. Those are the charges to you. We will wait for your go-ahead before starting.
why: SPEC §5.5 excludes customer-facing quotes; the breakdown expressly gives customer charges, not the sender's input costs.

subject: Cover bundle
body: For your order, the second cushion cover is half the price of the first. The first is 30, so the pair comes to 45. This offer applies to the plain fabric you selected.
why: SPEC §5.5 excludes customer-facing prices; the ratio describes an actual customer bundle price, not margin or cost.

subject: Saturday workshop rate
body: The public booking rate is 18 per place, including materials. That's the same rate shown on the sign-up card. We can reserve the places once you confirm the number attending.
why: SPEC §5.5 does not flag customer-facing prices; a published workshop rate is not an internal budget or cost.

subject: Corrected service amount
body: Sorry, the earlier note had the wrong total. Your service bill is 54, not 64. The corrected amount includes the new brake cable and the adjustment we agreed.
why: SPEC §5.5 excludes invoice amounts stated as facts; this corrects the recipient's bill without revealing our costs.

subject: Plinth hire quote
body: The quote to you is 120 for the weekend hire and remains valid until Friday. Collection on Monday morning is included. Please reply with the colour you prefer if you want to book it.
why: SPEC §5.5 does not flag customer quotes and payment terms; quote validity does not reveal a reserved negotiation position.

subject: Offer for your session
body: I can offer you the afternoon studio slot for 85, including the backdrop stand. You can accept by replying to this email before Thursday. We'd be pleased to host the session.
why: SPEC §5.6 does not flag an offer or proposal actually made to the recipient; this is an actionable studio offer.

subject: Revised crate offer
body: Following your request, our revised offer to you is 3 per crate for the week. That replaces the earlier quoted rate. Please confirm if you'd like us to reserve the stack.
why: SPEC §5.6 excludes an offer actually made to the recipient; the revised price is offered now, not described as hidden flexibility.

subject: Payment proposal for you
body: We offer you payment in two equal instalments, one on delivery and one a month later. The total quoted price stays the same. If you accept those terms, reply and we will issue the order confirmation.
why: SPEC §5.6 does not flag a proposal actually made to the recipient; these payment terms are the proposal itself.

subject: Updated hire offer
body: We can include the extra rehearsal hour at no charge in your booking. This is our offer to you for next week's session. Please let us know by tomorrow whether you want that slot.
why: SPEC §5.6 excludes an offer actually made to the recipient, including the offered extra hour; no unoffered fallback is disclosed.

subject: Support package proposal
body: Our proposal to you includes weekday support and a monthly content update. The package price is 160 per month. You may accept the proposal by email and we will agree the start date.
why: SPEC §5.6 does not flag a proposal actually made to the recipient; SPEC §5.5 also excludes its customer-facing price.

subject: Our response to your offer
body: Thanks for your offer. Our counteroffer to you is 75 for the fortnight, including the mounting. If that works for you, we can confirm the display dates today.
why: SPEC §5.6 excludes an offer actually made to the recipient; this counteroffer is being made, not predicted or reserved.

subject: Smaller catalogue option
body: As an alternative, we offer you an eight-page catalogue using the same cover design. The price for that option is 310. Please choose whichever proposal suits your publication plan.
why: SPEC §5.6 excludes actual proposals to the recipient; the alternative scope and price are customer offers.

subject: Group booking offer
body: For your group we offer the morning tour at 12 per person if you book by Wednesday. The guide and printed map are included. Reply with the group size to accept.
why: SPEC §5.6 does not flag an actual recipient-directed offer; its acceptance deadline is an offered term, not negotiation strategy.

subject: Service terms for your office
body: We propose next-working-day attendance for your office under the standard service plan. This replaces the previous two-day option in our offer. Please confirm whether you wish to proceed on that basis.
why: SPEC §5.6 excludes an actual proposal made to the recipient; the revised attendance term is openly offered.

subject: Microphone package for you
body: Here's our offer: both microphones, the receiver and the stands for 95 for the day. Setup at your venue is included. You can accept the whole package by replying yes to the booking desk.
why: SPEC §5.6 does not flag an offer actually made to the recipient; SPEC §5.5 excludes the quoted package price.

subject: Your knee appointment
body: Pella, your knee rehabilitation session is booked for Tuesday. Please bring the exercise sheet we gave you so we can go through it together. This message is addressed only to you.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag a person's own details written to that person; Pella alone receives her own treatment appointment.

subject: After your filling
body: Orven, the sensitivity after your filling should be discussed at your follow-up appointment. Please tell us if you need to change the booked time. We have sent this note directly to you.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes a person's own details written to that person; the treatment belongs to sole recipient Orven.

subject: Your pay confirmation
body: Senri, your monthly salary is 2800 under the agreement you accepted. This confirms your own pay figure for your records. Please reply if your copy of the agreement shows anything different.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag a person's own details written to that person; sole recipient Senri is receiving their own salary confirmation.

subject: Your bonus
body: Vella, your bonus for this period is 450. It will be included with your next pay. This is your individual confirmation, sent to you alone.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes a person's own details written to that person; Vella alone receives Vella's bonus amount.

subject: Your warning letter discussion
body: Derren, this confirms the written warning we discussed with you this morning. You can send us your response before the follow-up meeting. No one else is copied into this email.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag a person's own details written to that person; the warning concerns sole recipient Derren.

subject: Your consultation
body: Mavri, your appointment to discuss your divorce papers is on Thursday. Please bring your questions and the copy you have already marked up. We will work through them with you at the meeting.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes a person's own details written to that person; Mavri is the sole recipient of their own family-matter appointment.

subject: Your court preparation meeting
body: Jelro, we have booked time to discuss the charge against you before your court appearance. Please confirm whether you can attend the preparation meeting on Monday. This note goes directly to you.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag a person's own details written to that person; the legal matter concerns sole recipient Jelro.

subject: Your pickup time
body: Nellin, your transport for dialysis is booked for the morning session. Please be ready at the agreed pickup point. Reply directly if you need to change your own booking.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes a person's own details written to that person; sole recipient Nellin receives their own treatment-related transport note.

subject: Your daughter's exercises
body: Ressa, your daughter Merli's physiotherapy review is next week. Please bring the exercise record you have been keeping for her. We are sending this reminder to you as her parent.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the parent they concern; sole recipient Ressa is explicitly Merli's parent.

subject: Your son's dental review
body: Tovin, your son Fenno is due for the review of his dental brace. Please contact the desk to choose a suitable appointment. This reminder is for you as his father.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes details written to the parent; Fenno's brace review is sent only to his father Tovin.

subject: Your child's test results
body: Kella, the results of your child Oveli's hearing test are ready to discuss. Please book a call with the clinic. As Oveli's mother, you are the intended recipient of this note.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the parent; Kella is explicitly the child's mother and sole recipient.

subject: Your son's next session
body: Pevra, your son Remni's speech therapy session has moved to the afternoon. The exercises remain the same until then. This update is addressed to you as his parent.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes details written to the parent they concern; the child's therapy update goes only to parent Pevra.

subject: Please collect your daughter
body: Arven, your daughter Selli has developed a fever and needs collecting from the school office. Please reply to confirm you have seen this. We are contacting you as her father.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the parent; this illness notification goes solely to Selli's father.

subject: Support appointment for your child
body: Vorna, we have reserved the counselling session you requested for your child Evin following the family bereavement. Please confirm whether the afternoon time suits. We are writing to you as Evin's parent.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes details written to the parent they concern; the support arrangement is directed solely to the requesting parent.

subject: Review for your ward
body: Yelna, as Melli's legal guardian, please confirm her mobility review appointment. The clinic will discuss her physiotherapy progress with you there. You are the only recipient of this reminder.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the guardian they concern; Yelna's guardianship and sole receipt are explicit.

subject: Dental visit for your ward
body: Rovan, your ward Jessa's dental treatment appointment is on Friday. Please bring the consent form you received as her guardian. We will review it with you before the appointment.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes details written to the guardian; Jessa's treatment reminder goes only to guardian Rovan.

subject: Your ward's review
body: Elvi, the seizure clinic review for your ward Parnel has been moved to Tuesday. We are notifying you as his legal guardian. Please let the clinic know if that time is unsuitable.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the guardian they concern; sole recipient Elvi is explicitly Parnel's legal guardian.

subject: Next therapy session
body: Orla, as legal guardian for your ward Selrin, you can book his next occupational therapy session with the desk. Please bring the activity notes from home. This message is for you alone.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes details written to the guardian; sole recipient Orla receives the therapy arrangement in that role.

subject: Thimble's teeth
body: Verri, your rabbit Thimble is due for his dental review. Please bring him in his usual carrier. We are writing directly to you as his owner.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the pet owner they concern; Thimble's dental reminder goes only to his owner.

subject: Pebble's booster
body: Nelva, your dog Pebble's booster is due this month. Please call the desk to arrange a time. We have addressed this reminder to you as Pebble's owner.
why: SPEC §5.4 explicitly excludes pet-owner messages such as an animal's booster reminder; sole recipient Nelva owns Pebble.
